summary: Both renders clearly read as a practical, human-scaled spear. The 2.12 m measured length is physically plausible and correctly independent of the 2.6 m gameplay reach. Its slim ash haft, restrained leather grip, socketed leaf head, and butt shoe form a coherent construction without toy-like bulk or decoration. The edge-on view makes the blade very slight, but the angled render supplies enough leaf profile and forged faceting to remain convincing. Material separation is subdued but legible, and 472 triangles suits the Halo CE-era crude-realism target. The documented +X direction, integration origin, grip/tip/spearhead markers, and separated functional parts are useful. README claims agree with metrics and do not misuse catalogue scale.
